title: thelypteris crinipes
intro: Thelypteris crinipes, commonly known as the lady fern, is a species of fern native to tropical Africa. The health benefits of this plant include its use as a treatment for fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris crinipes include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
